text:
No hiring choice can be put forward yet, because the **£400k/year salary constraint was not checkable** in this run.

- The comparison is **very low robustness** and rests on three Olumi-supplied values, not user evidence; delivery capacity, onboarding load, and annual salary spend are the key assumptions.
- The analysis did compare all four scenarios, but it could not assess budget compliance: annual salary spend is modelled as a calculated change rather than a salary figure in **£/year**.
- The goal direction was also assumed to mean “higher is better”, rather than stated.

To make the Q3-and-budget question decision-useful, the model needs annual fully loaded salary figures (and current salary spend) expressed in £/year.
